newsitem.title: JAPAN: Marubeni, others in $1.5 bln gas pipeline project.
newsitem.headline: Marubeni, others in $1.5 bln gas pipeline project.

text.p: Marubeni Corp said on Monday that it and three other companies, including Mobil Corp and Alberta Energy Co Ltd, will build a 3,100 km gas pipeline between Argentina and Brazil.
A Marubeni spokesman said construction of the pipeline was expected to be completed in 2001.
The project, worth $1.5 billion, will be operated through a joint venture, it said.
Construction of the pipeline will begin in the second half of 1999.
Alberta Energy will take a 55 percent stake and Mobil 25 percent in the joint venture, while Marubeni and an Argentine oil company are each to take 10 percent.
The gas pipes will be procured from Japanese and Brazilian makers, including Nippon Steel Corp and NKK Corp, the Marubeni spokesman said.
The gas will be purchased by Petrobras, a state-owned Brazilian oil company.
